blocks.text: The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell.
blocks.explanation: Mitochondria generate most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), used as a source of chemical energy. This is why they are commonly referred to as the powerhouse of the cell.

terms.definition: Organelles that produce energy for the cell.
A metaphor for the main source of energy.
